note: Scripture follows the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, lug_bib), parsed from the ebible mirror's USX. Rows were derived by measurement, not from the translators' reports: a row is `mined` only when the translator claimed OLCB wording AND the block (or a neighbour, since translators numbered blocks differently) contains either a quoted span that is a verbatim OLCB substring or a run of six consecutive OLCB words. Everything else is `self_rendered` with the translator's reason, so the count errs toward review.

Chapters 3 and 4 reuse the shipped Luganda sermons the-golden-key-of-prayer and order-and-argument-in-prayer (quote marks converted to curly to mirror this book's English); their rows come from a separate audit of that text, which also found and fixed meaning errors in both sermons in this PR. Chapter 13 is a fresh translation: the shipped the-ravens-cry.lg sermon was audited and found unreliable, so it was not reused.
Spurgeon cites rarely; every reference was identified by the translators or auditors from the English. AI-drafted, awaiting native review.
